slides.title: Concrete screws
slides.text: For the connection of primary or secondary elements to a concrete base structure — zinc-plated, ETA-grade performance, ready in every diameter.

slides.title: Heavy-duty metal anchors
slides.text: Drop-in and expansion anchors for cracked and non-cracked concrete. Safe, certified holding power for structural fixings.

slides.title: Chemical anchoring systems
slides.text: Adhesive anchors, mesh and plastic sleeves plus applicator guns — complete chemical fixing kits for solid and hollow materials.

slides.title: Roofing & facade screws
slides.text: Stainless and zinc-plated self-drilling screws, painted heads and sealing washers — certified excellence for roofing and cladding.

slides.title: Insulation & frame fixings
slides.text: Nylon plugs for thermal insulation, polyethylene frame anchors and caps — quick, safe installation on every base material.
